      Problem: The watchdog loop's `sleep` duration is now directly controlled by the user-configurable `REVIEW_PR_STATE_POLL_INTERVAL_SECS` (10..3600), but this loop also handles critical safety checks: `reviewer_idle_timeout` (default 900s) and `reviewer_max_wall` (default 7200s).; If a user sets the poll interval to 3600s, the watchdog will only wake up once per hour.
